  <h1 class="title">AI Briefing</h1>
  <p class="dek">Twitter/X, filtered down to what actually matters, delivered to Telegram twice a day.</p>

  <h2 class="h2">Why</h2>
  <p>I was spending more time scrolling than learning. I wanted a system that reads everything so I don't have to, and only surfaces what's worth acting on.</p>

  <h2 class="h2">How it works</h2>
  <p>Curated X lists feed through RSSHub, get deduplicated semantically, then get classified by Claude CLI into four buckets &mdash; act now, queue, inform, skip &mdash; weighted by a rolling 30-day credibility score per source. A weekly agent maps connections between the notes I save. Runs locally: Python, Redis, SQLite, Docker.</p>

  <h2 class="h2">What I learned</h2>
  <p>Four categories was the right number. Three collapses &quot;important&quot; into &quot;urgent.&quot; Five is more than I'll ever triage consistently.</p>
